SELECT P.PATIENT_ID, P.P_FIRST_NAME, P.P_AGE, A.APP_NUMBER, A.APP_DATE
FROM PATIENT P, APPOINMENT A
WHERE P.PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID
    AND A.APP_REASON = 'FEVER'
ORDER BY P.PATIENT_ID;
